description_en: Deletes one or more staging (grayscale) configurations for an accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用DeleteDcdnSpecificStagingConfig删除加速域名的配置（灰度）
name: DeleteDcdnSpecificStagingConfig

parameters.description_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name.
parameters.description_zh: 加速域名，仅支持传单个域名。
parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，仅支持传单个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.description_en:
The configuration ID. To specify multiple configuration IDs, separate them with commas (,).

Call the [DescribeDcdnDomainStagingConfig](~~DescribeDcdnDomainStagingConfig~~) operation to query configuration IDs.
